title: Generic weak future inextendibility near a fixed rotating Kerr datum
exact_target: For every fixed Kerr mass $M>0$ and nonzero subextremal rotation $|a|<M$, is there a sufficiently small neighborhood of its asymptotically flat vacuum initial datum, in the stated weighted smooth topology, in which future $C^0$ intersect $W^{1,2}_loc-extendible$ maximal developments form a meagre set? Equivalently ask for a residual set of weakly future-inextendible data.
